articles.description: Manchester United see Como's Nico Paz as a possible replacement for Bruno Fernandes. For his part, Paz is at least open to it. Transfer Talk has the latest.

images.caption: Shaka Hislop and Steve Nicol question whether Manchester United are at risk of relegation from the Premier League.

articles.headline: Cesc Fàbregas plays down Barcelona links, pledges immediate future to Como

articles.headline: Transfer rumors, news: Arsenal, Newcastle eye Inter's Pio Esposito
articles.description: Both Arsenal and Newcastle United are looking to improve their attack by signing Inter's Pio Esposito. Transfer Talk has the latest.

images.name: Burley questions Man United's desire after Anfield collapse
images.caption: Craig Burley explains why he finds Manchester United's mentality the most worrying part of their start to the season.

articles.headline: Lazio are top of Serie A despite playing without their fans
articles.description: Lazio's success this season has been one of the big stories in Serie A, made more remarkable by the fact that their fans won't attend home games until the club is sold.

articles.headline: Milan into top four as classy Pulisic solo goal caps Serie A rout

articles.headline: Scott McTominay sinks Torino to end Napoli's three-game winless streak
articles.description: Scott McTominay's second-half strike earned Napoli a hard-fought 1-0 win over Torino to ease the pressure on manager Massimiliano Allegri.
